verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows that Square has a Payouts API (a bare page title), alongside separate Refunds and application-fee docs and a marketing claim about reconciling sales in one report. Nothing documents what a payout breakdown contains or how the payout schedule is set. missing for 10: any evidence of payout schedule control, documented per-payout entry breakdown of charges/fees/refunds, reconciliation detail beyond a page title, independent or hands-on corroboration
